description: Change of use of Arches S2-S13, S16-S17, E4-E5 and N6 from Light Industrial (B1c) and Hot Food Takeaway (Sui Generis) to Class E (excluding E(c)(i) Financial services and E(g)(i) Offices).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

E-100 Location Plan, E-100 As Existing, E-100 As Proposed, letter reference NFD/BWA/J10003, Design and Access Statement dated 02/03/2026.  

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Class E of the Schedule of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order, the proposed Class E units hereby approved shall not be used for financial services (Class E(c)(i)) or as offices to carry out any operational or administrative functions (Class E(g)(i)).
 
Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the units contributes to the retail function, vibrancy and vitality of the site and Camden Town Centre in accordance with policies TC2, TC4, TC5 and TC6 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - Should any of the arches be used for restaurant purposes, the use shall not be carried out outside the following times:

07:00 - 00:00 Monday to Sunday and on Public/Bank Holidays [this includes no customers on the premises outside this time].  

Retail - 07:00 to 22:00 Monday to Sunday and on Public / Bank Holidays

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies TC2, A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration-isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 7 - No hot food cooking shall take place until full details of fume and odour control measures are submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Control measures shall be those recommended within the EMAQ guidance document on odours from commercial kitchens (EMAQ+, 2022) for kitchens. All such measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the manufacturers' recommendations. No hot food cooking shall take place in the units unless the odour control and extracts are operational. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by smell, steam and other effluent in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 8 - Prior to commencement of primary cooking within any of the units, details of a cleaning and maintenance schedule and/or maintenance contract for the extract and odour control systems shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The extract and odour control systems shall not be operated other than in accordance with the maintenance and cleaning schedule thus approved. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by smell, steam and other effluent in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
